description: This circular walk explores the area surrounding the Cambridgeshire village of Fenstanton. It's a lovely area for an easy stroll with flat paths taking you to the River Ouse and the wildlife rich Fen Drayton Lakes Nature Reserve. You'll enjoy some fine views across the surrounding countryside while walking along the riverside and lakeside paths. You can continue your walking in the area by visiting nearby Hemingford Grey and the popular town of St Ives .
